zh.text: James E. Thorne 回覆 @vexor4i：當通脹下降時，維持利率不變按定義即是緊縮。

en.text: James E. Thorne replies to @vexor4i: When inflation falls, keeping rates steady by definition is tightening.

zh.text: First Squawk：IMF 的 Georgieva 表示全球通脹上升增加多個經濟體貨幣政策緊縮的必要性。

en.text: First Squawk: IMF's Georgieva says higher global inflation is increasing the need for monetary policy tightening across multiple economies.

zh.text: 週一，舊金山聯邦儲備銀行、Warsh主席和聯邦儲備委員會舉辦了生產力和就業工作組會議。

en.text: On Monday, the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Chairman Warsh, and the Federal Reserve Board hosted the Productivity and Jobs Task Force Conference.

zh.text: 風險持續上升。我們現在處於清算階段。數據中心、就業與政治：這是同一筆交易。很快：AI 解除遇上美元毀滅球遇上衰退風險。波動性不等於賣出底部。數據中心政治遇上循環融資：2008 風格。正面市場廣度無法修復。$NVDA

en.text: The risks keep rising. We Are In A Liquidation Phase Now. Data Centers, Jobs & Politics: It’s All One Trade. Soon: AI Unwind Meets Dollar Wrecking Ball Meets Recession Risk. Volatility Does Not Equal Selling Bottom. Politics Of Datacenters Meet Circular Financing: 2008-Style. Positive Market Breadth Won’t Fix It. $NVDA

zh.text: 債券。好消息：如果你將辛苦賺來的資本從 $QQQ 重新配置到 $TLT，你做了正確的 #Quad4 動作。債券市場波動率繼續下降 = 對債券看漲。

en.text: BONDS. Good news: if you re-allocated your hard-earned capital out of $QQQ and into $TLT you made the right #Quad4 move. Bond Markt Vol continues to break down = Bullish for Bonds.

zh.text: juan_gonzalesP 指出 @robin_j_brooks 剛剛標誌了宏觀中最重要的脫鉤：美元正在飆升，但它沒有追蹤利率差異。這是信用事件信號，不是利率交易。

en.text: juan_gonzalesP notes @robin_j_brooks just flagged the most important decoupling in macro: the dollar is surging, but it is NOT tracking rate differentials. This is a credit event signal, not a rates trade.

zh.text: First Squawk：布倫特原油期貨上漲 1.08 美元至每桶 93.03 美元。

en.text: First Squawk: Brent crude futures edge higher by $1.08 to $93.03/bbl.

zh.text: 晶片是否正經歷最差階段？對晶片股，這可能是週期最醜陋的階段。但股價下跌與業務惡化有重大差異。$NVDA 超預期、上調展望，仍收於 52 週低點以下。領導不確定性、中國限制、出口管制審查、AI 融資問題壓制。提及 $AMD $CBRS $MSFT $NVDA $SMCI。

en.text: Are Chips Going Through Their Worst Phase? For chip stocks, this may be the ugliest phase of the cycle. But difference between falling stock prices and deteriorating businesses. $NVDA beat expectations, raised outlook, still closed below 52-week low. Leadership uncertainty, China restrictions, export-control scrutiny, AI financing questions weighing. Mentions $AMD $CBRS $MSFT $NVDA $SMCI.

zh.text: 納斯達克本益比：2000年對2026年 $NDX $QQQ。2000年3月納斯達克綜合指數約190倍Trailing Earnings，2026年11月約30倍，低約6倍。目前倍數遠低於網路泡沫高峰期的極端估值與普遍缺乏盈利狀況。

en.text: Nasdaq P/E: 2000 vs 2026 $NDX $QQQ. March 2000 Nasdaq Composite at roughly 190x trailing earnings, November 2026 around 30x, about 6x lower. Current multiples nowhere near dot-com peak extremes of high valuations and lack of profits.
